# TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest) Documentation

> Documentation for TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) - cross-browser and real-device testing, automation, AI agents, accessibility, analytics, and integrations.

This is a short index. Fetch the product index you need rather than the whole corpus.

Each product index below lists its pages with links to the plain-Markdown copy at `/support/docs/<slug>.md`.

All docs: https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms-full.txt
Site index: https://www.testmuai.com/llms.txt
All site pages: https://www.testmuai.com/llms-full.txt
Agent instructions: https://www.testmuai.com/agents.md
Sitemap: https://www.testmuai.com/support/sitemap.xml
OpenAPI: https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/OpenAPI.md

## Agent skill

- [TestMu AI Documentation Skill](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/SKILL.md): Product-specific operating guidance for AI agents (agentskills.io format) - how to discover docs, choose the right product area, and follow common testing workflows.

## Product Indexes

- [KaneAI and Kane CLI](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/kane.txt): 141 documents. KaneAI test authoring, Kane CLI commands and flags, credits, and CI usage.
- [Agent Testing, MCP Server, and Browser Cloud](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/agents-and-mcp.txt): 105 documents. Agent testing and assurance, MCP server setup and tools, Browser Cloud sessions and SDKs.
- [HyperExecute](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/hyperexecute.txt): 178 documents. HyperExecute YAML, execution strategies, jobs, artifacts, and CI setup.
- [Web Automation Frameworks](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/web-automation.txt): 188 documents. Framework setup, capabilities, parallel execution, and debugging for web automation.
- [Mobile App Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/app-testing.txt): 165 documents. App upload, real device and emulator execution, native app automation frameworks.
- [SmartUI and Visual Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/visual-testing.txt): 124 documents. SmartUI CLI and SDKs, baselines, comparisons, and visual review workflows.
- [Accessibility Testing](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/accessibility.txt): 187 documents. Accessibility automation, DevTools, app scanner, rules, and reporting.
- [Integrations](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/integrations.txt): 149 documents. Per-tool setup for Jira, Slack, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure, and many more.
- [Test Analytics and Test Manager](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/analytics.txt): 94 documents. Dashboards and widgets, flaky test analysis, test cases, runs, and milestones.
- [Platform, Access, and Security](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/platform-and-security.txt): 67 documents. Tunnel setup, SSO and SCIM, account and org settings, billing, and concurrency.
- [Other Documentation](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms/other.txt): 41 documents. Overviews, release notes, and reference material spanning several products.

## Complete Docs List

- [All documentation pages](https://www.testmuai.com/support/docs/llms-full.txt): every documentation page in one file with title, description, and URL.
